notes.title: Update 1.3.9 adds Japanese to Pumpkin Jack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104412/87c1685b307aa6ec417a992e994b70dc48b43da7.jpg[/img]

Spooky scary greetings, friends!

All the best and stay healthy everyone!

notes.title: Version 1.3.8 is now live! Also, Steam Trading Cards incoming! 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104412/61bde0f69f41b6ce742b5ac47719e9a7aba1b746.jpg[/img]

Spooky scary greetings, friends!

Folks, I am still totally blown away by the overwhelmingly positive feedback I received since the launch of the game – and the constructive suggestions, of course. So, this new update for Pumpkin Jack (1.3.8) is mainly based on the feedback I received from the community! 

[b]And this is what the new update brings to of you all:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a FOV parameter to the video options
[*] Added HDR support to the video options (only effective for HDR compatible displays)
[*] Added Portuguese - Brazil language to Pumpkin Jack
[*] Added a new timer mode for speedrunner: The full game timer
- This mode enables you to have a timer that takes previous levels in considerations, and give a clean timer for completing the full game from A to Z
- When this mode is enabled, ending a level will put you at the beginning of the next one, no matter if you had a save in this level or not
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where achievements didn’t unlocked properly on level 1
[*] Fixed the speedrun timer look
[*] Fixed a bug where the timer was still counting during mini-game cutscenes
[*] Fixed a bug where the continue button was loading the final boss scene, even if there was no save in level 6
[*] Fixed a bug where opening level 6 from the level selector was opening the final boss scene, even if it was already done. This was blocking people from replaying the level 6 for collection purpose.
[/list]

[b]Oh, and I almost forgot:[/b] From now on the Steam Trading Cards for [b]Pumpkin Jack[/b] are also available! Have fun collecting them!

Thank you all very, very much for your ongoing feedback and support - it's really appreciated! ❤️

All the best and stay healthy everyone!
Nicolas

notes.title: Version 1.3.7 is now live - We fixed even more things! 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104412/9bec4b82b576fd815114c143a37db76ad855456f.jpg[/img]

Spooky scary greetings, friends!

Thanks to all your feedback, we managed to improve the game even further. The new version 1.3.7 for [b]Pumpkin Jack[/b] went live a couple of hours ago. Here are the (few) changes that are part of the update:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Jack dying in a loop on the water during the boat sequences (again)
[*] Fixed a bug where the player had to replay the boat sequence if dying during the second race of level 4
[*] Fixed a bug where the input hints where showing "Error" while playing with a controller
[/list]
Folks, I am really blown away by the overwhelmingly positive feedback I received over the last days! Thank you all very very much for your ongoing feedback and support - it's really appreciated! ❤️

All the best and stay healthy everyone!
Nicolas

All the best and stay healthy everyone!

notes.title: Pumpkin Jack - Version 1.3.4 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104412/9548d51504bbbe2cfdbccc754b75a5d9e64d1491.jpg[/img]

Spooky scary greetings everyone,

We are still going through the great feedback all of you are sending us.
Some of you also reported some problems with the game, which is why we worked on a first little update.

[b]Version 1.3.4[/b]
[list]
[*]An issue with the timer was fixed
[*]It's now easier to handle the minecart
[*]Fixed an issue with the vortex in level 6 
[*]Better chances to survive the boss fight, even with low fps
[*]RTX low framerate during the horse section is now fixed
[*]A small bug that might happen during the cinematics was fixed
[*]We have added a DirectX launcher to the game (You can now choose between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12)
[/list]

All the best and stay healthy!
Nicolas
